positionX.description: Horizontal alignment of the notification popup and control center.

positionY.description: Vertical alignment of the notification popup and control center.

layer.description: Layer group for the notification window (overlay, top, bottom).

control_center_layer.description: Layer group for the control center window.

layer_shell_cover_screen.description: Cover the entire screen with layer-shell.

control_center_margin_top.description: Margin top for the control center in pixels.

control_center_margin_bottom.description: Margin bottom for the control center in pixels.

control_center_margin_right.description: Margin right for the control center in pixels.

control_center_margin_left.description: Margin left for the control center in pixels.

notification_2fa_action.description: Enable the 2FA action button in notifications.

notification_inline_replies.description: Enable inline reply functionality in notifications.

notification_icon_size.description: Size of the notification icon in pixels.

notification_body_image_height.description: Height of inline images in the notification body.

notification_body_image_width.description: Width of inline images in the notification body.

timeout.description: Default timeout for notifications in seconds.

timeout_critical.description: Timeout for 'Critical' urgency notifications (0 for never).

fit_to_screen.description: Fit the notification popup to the screen width.

relative_timestamps.description: Display relative timestamps (e.g., '2 min ago') instead of absolute.

control_center_width.description: Width of the control center in pixels.

control_center_height.description: Height of the control center in pixels.

notification_window_width.description: Width of the individual notification window in pixels.

image_visibility.description: When to show images in notifications (always, when-available, never).

hide_on_clear.description: Hide the notification popup when the control center is cleared.

hide_on_action.description: Hide the notification popup when an action is taken.

text_empty.description: Text displayed when the notification list is empty.

script_fail_notify.description: Show a notification if a custom script fails.
